Name: Mateo Scarecrows
Author: Acc9000
Description:
There are 2 variants, choose your download in Files:

Fashion - featuring several of the many cute outfits Mateo has

Action - featuring action poses for more menace to the crows. :)


Deluxe scarecrow is a separate mod (download separately from Files)


----

Mateo is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword & Sorcery[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/95913693]DestyN0VA[/url] and the Adventuring Party

Art is by Axell - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/130369223]7thAxis[/url]


----
